# Video gallery

Every public video on the [ALS Geospatial Hub YouTube channel](https://www.youtube.com/@alsgeospatialhub5222), the channel GeoALS uses for map demonstrations, webinars and advocacy walk-throughs. Each card has a description and links to the maps shown, and selecting a card plays the video on this page. The list was read from the channel on 12 November 2026, and a scheduled workflow in the repository adds new uploads.

<p><a href="#care">Care</a> · <a href="#research">Research</a> · <a href="#advocacy">Advocacy</a> · <a href="#stories">Stories</a> · <a href="#all-uploads">All uploads in one player</a> · <a href="#related-videos-on-other-channels">Related videos on other channels</a></p>

## Research

Webinars and presentations about the maps and the analyses behind them.

<div class="videos" markdown="0">

## Advocacy

Walk-throughs of the legislative maps.

<div class="videos" markdown="0">
<article class="video" id="v-Cqv6NQdl94E"><div class="frame"><img loading="lazy" alt="" src="https://i.ytimg.com/vi/Cqv6NQdl94E/hqdefault.jpg"><button type="button" data-id="Cqv6NQdl94E" data-title="Reauthorization Act for ALS Map" aria-label="Play video: Reauthorization Act for ALS Map"><span>Play video</span></button></div><div class="body"><h3>Reauthorization Act for ALS Map</h3><p class="meta">Published 2026-04-29 · <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Cqv6NQdl94E">Watch on YouTube</a></p><p>A walk through the map that shows whether each United States Representative has cosponsored the reauthorization of the Accelerating Access to Critical Therapies for ALS Act (ACT for ALS). Where a Representative has not signed on, the map supplies district facts an advocate can use when writing or calling. <a href="https://experience.arcgis.com/experience/432276c3289a4839be09c409b817ebd2">Glen Rouse ALS Legislative Viewer</a>.</p></div></article>
<article class="video" id="v-_Mt1LcQK37c"><div class="frame"><img loading="lazy" alt="" src="https://i.ytimg.com/vi/_Mt1LcQK37c/hqdefault.jpg"><button type="button" data-id="_Mt1LcQK37c" data-title="GeoALS - 9 days to Christmas" aria-label="Play video: GeoALS - 9 days to Christmas"><span>Play video</span></button></div><div class="body"><h3>GeoALS - 9 days to Christmas</h3><p class="meta">Published 2025-12-16 · <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_Mt1LcQK37c">Watch on YouTube</a></p><p>Part of a holiday countdown of ways to support the ALS community. It shows how to find your legislators, see their record on ALS legislation, and check whether they belong to the ALS Caucus. <a href="https://experience.arcgis.com/experience/432276c3289a4839be09c409b817ebd2">Glen Rouse ALS Legislative Viewer</a>.</p></div></article>
<article class="video" id="v-nBxY4QUmHhY"><div class="frame"><img loading="lazy" alt="" src="https://i.ytimg.com/vi/nBxY4QUmHhY/hqdefault.jpg"><button type="button" data-id="nBxY4QUmHhY" data-title="Glen Rouse ALS Legislative Viewer 2.0" aria-label="Play video: Glen Rouse ALS Legislative Viewer 2.0"><span>Play video</span></button></div><div class="body"><h3>Glen Rouse ALS Legislative Viewer 2.0</h3><p class="meta">Published 2025-05-03 · <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nBxY4QUmHhY">Watch on YouTube</a></p><p>A tour of version 2.0 of the Glen Rouse ALS Legislative Viewer. For each member of Congress the viewer reports support for ALS policy, alongside facts about the ALS community in that state or district that advocates can bring to meetings about research funding and access to treatment. <a href="https://experience.arcgis.com/experience/432276c3289a4839be09c409b817ebd2">Glen Rouse ALS Legislative Viewer</a>.</p></div></article>
<article class="video" id="v-1ngmbjqH-fg"><div class="frame"><img loading="lazy" alt="" src="https://i.ytimg.com/vi/1ngmbjqH-fg/hqdefault.jpg"><button type="button" data-id="1ngmbjqH-fg" data-title="Continue to fund the CDC National ALS Registry" aria-label="Play video: Continue to fund the CDC National ALS Registry"><span>Play video</span></button></div><div class="body"><h3>Continue to fund the CDC National ALS Registry</h3><p class="meta">Published 2025-04-26 · <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1ngmbjqH-fg">Watch on YouTube</a></p><p>A message from GeoALS founder Pat Dolan about the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) National ALS Registry and Biorepository, recorded after a draft federal budget memo proposed ending its funding. The video describes what the Registry has supported since 2010 and asks viewers to contact their legislators. <a href="https://www.cdc.gov/als/">CDC National ALS Registry</a>.</p></div></article>
